captured_from: full suite run 2026-09-08, BEFORE any P1a deletion (2,593 collected, 2,561 passed, 26 failed, 6 skipped)
what_this_is: Known-failing tests, accepted as a pre-existing baseline on Ananth's ruling 2026-09-08: 'we have had these failures for a while.' The gate SUBTRACTS this set -- a test failing here is not a regression. A test failing that is NOT here IS a regression and fails the gate. A test in here that starts passing is reported so the list can shrink. The list may shrink, never grow, without an explicit decision.

shrink_log.why: test_latency_no_regrets patched orchestrator.clear_progress, which is not an attribute of that module and never has been — the test failed on that regardless of use_react. Chat Master removed the bogus patch while the file was open for the deletion. A pre-existing failure genuinely fixed, not a regression masked: verified by re-running the full suite independently.

P1b triage. All 11 were STALE TESTS, not code defects — each encoded an old contract the code had deliberately moved past, and each was verified against live behaviour before the assertion was changed. (a) search_corpus now declares itself as a 'search_corpus:' Can/Cannot block, not a '(query)' signature — tool is registered and renders, only the assertion format was stale [2 tests]. (b) appeals table drops a column that is empty for EVERY row (2026-08-10 screenshot review); fixtures gave no authority so the column vanished. Added test_all_empty_authority_column_is_dropped, which had no coverage [2 tests]. (c) _corpus_confidence_min gained a chat_mode argument; the test pinned the empty-paren literal [1]. (d) FOLLOW_UP_CAPABLE lock missed payor_lookup/assign_task/patch_task, all genuinely registered follow_up_capable=True [1]. (e) _execute_tool gained an open_gaps kwarg; one fake had a fixed 4-arg signature, so the TypeError was swallowed and the retry never fired [1]. (f) consolidator emits pre_built_sections, not raw tool_section_hints, and a table hint now needs table_headers as well as rows [1]. (g) llm_calls INSERT gained composition_id/composition_hash/is_hard_pinned/module_key/variant_id; the record fixture lacked them and the KeyError was swallowed into a silent no-op [1]. (h) SECURITY-ADJACENT, flagged: the two b1d restoration-banner tests asserted auth_scope=='global' for an UNAUTHENTICATED caller. That path was deliberately removed because returning cross-session uploads to an unauthenticated caller is a data-isolation violation. The tests documented the vulnerability, not a requirement. Rewritten to assert the secure behaviour and to exercise the current-thread filter authenticated. DO NOT restore the global path [2]. Gate after: regressions 0, newly passing 11, 14 remaining (12 interpreter artifacts + 2 intentional size ratchets).
